news.title: Study Abroad Trip to Spain, Portugal Opens Student Eyes
news.summary_en: From milking calves at a cheese farm outside of Oviedo, Spain, to learning how to make authentic Basque cuisine in a culinary class in Bilbao and witnessing pilgrims complete The Camino at the Cathedral of Santiago de Compostela, this trip was full of experiences that showcased the rich culture and history of the Iberian Peninsula and pushed students beyond their norms.
